verdict: Ads are working; leads aren't landing due to an intake gap.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads recorded 16 conversions and your Google Business Profile generated 42 calls and 41 direction requests — real activity from real people. However, zero of those contacts are showing up as confirmed leads in your CRM, and the data confirms the ads are not the problem: the intake process has a gap that is preventing inquiries from being captured. Separately, Google Business Profile engagement dropped 51.6% week-over-week, with three near-zero days running into this week, which we are monitoring closely. Resolving the intake gap is the immediate priority, and confirming an intake owner by August 31 is the step that unlocks everything downstream.

watch_item.issue: Inquiries are reaching you but not being captured in your CRM — 16 ad conversions and 42 profile calls show demand, while CRM leads read zero.
watch_item.fix: The intake automation is being audited and an intake owner is being confirmed by August 31, which will close this gap and allow proper lead tracking to resume.
